name: analyze_pptx_gestalt_tool
description: Interpret a native PowerPoint slide scene graph using deterministic coordinate evidence plus a text model. Produces additive relationship enrichments; it never replaces the native BADGERS spine and does not consume slide pixels.

slide_scene_graph.description: JSON scene graph with normalized shape bounds, types, text, groups, and connector endpoints.

scene_graph_uri.description: S3 URI containing the JSON scene graph. Use instead of slide_scene_graph for large graphs.

deterministic_evidence_uri.description: S3 URI of the scene graph and calculated geometry evidence used for the enrichment.
